sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedanta.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: More than a hundred years ago, a Danish man named Edgar Rubin created an image.
sentences.zh: 一百多年前，一位名叫埃德加·鲁宾的丹麦人创作了一幅图像。

sentences.en: It became so popular, you can still buy posters of it today.
sentences.zh: 它变得非常流行，以至于今天你依然能买到它的海报。

sentences.en: The image is known as Rubin's vase.
sentences.zh: 这幅图像被称为“鲁宾之瓶”。

sentences.en: If you Google it right now, you might see a black vase against a white background.
sentences.zh: 如果你现在去谷歌搜索，你可能会看到一个白色背景下的黑色花瓶。

sentences.en: But if you stare at it, another image suddenly jumps out.
sentences.zh: 但如果你盯着它看，另一幅图像会突然跳出来。

sentences.en: Not a vase, but two faces in profile,
sentences.zh: 那不是花瓶，而是两个侧面人脸，

sentences.en: gazing at each other across a black background.
sentences.zh: 在黑色背景下彼此凝视。

sentences.en: Ruben wasn't an artiSt.
sentences.zh: 鲁宾并不是一位艺术家。

sentences.en: He was a psychologist,
sentences.zh: 他是一位心理学家，

sentences.en: and he was interested in how the mind deciphers visual cues.
sentences.zh: 他感兴趣的是大脑如何解读视觉线索。

sentences.en: There are many versions of Ruben's vase.
sentences.zh: 鲁宾之瓶有很多版本。

sentences.en: There's one where you see either a duck or a rabbit.
sentences.zh: 其中一个版本里，你看到的是鸭子或兔子。

sentences.en: Another where you see either a young girl or an old woman.
sentences.zh: 另一个版本里，你看到的是少女或老妇人。

sentences.en: The point is that it's either or.
sentences.zh: 重点在于，它非此即彼。

sentences.en: Your mind alternates between seeing one picture or the other, but not both.
sentences.zh: 你的大脑会在看到其中一幅画和另一幅画之间切换，但无法同时看到两者。

sentences.en: I've often tried to make myself see both the ways and the faces at the same time.
sentences.zh: 我经常尝试让自己同时看到花瓶和人脸。

sentences.en: It's really hard to do.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难做到。

sentences.en: But if I succeed, it's usually only for a moment.
sentences.zh: 但如果我成功了，通常也只能维持片刻。

sentences.en: Then my mind snaps back into the groove of seeing either one picture or the other.
sentences.zh: 然后我的大脑又会回到那种非此即彼的思维定式中。

sentences.en: Edgar Rubin's creation is a metaphor for our times.
sentences.zh: 埃德加·鲁宾的创作是我们这个时代的隐喻。

sentences.en: In so many ways, across so many domains, we are pulled toward either-or thinking.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，在许多领域，我们都被推向了非此即彼的思维方式。

sentences.en: Are the people around us friends or foes?
sentences.zh: 我们身边的人是朋友还是敌人？

sentences.en: Sinners or saints?
sentences.zh: 是圣人还是罪人？

sentences.en: Superheroes or supervillains?
sentences.zh: 是超级英雄还是超级反派？

sentences.en: What are we to make of the neighbor who brings us soup when we are sick,
sentences.zh: 我们该如何看待那个在我们生病时送来热汤，

sentences.en: but also shares vile opinions on social media?
sentences.zh: 却又在社交媒体上发表恶毒言论的邻居？

sentences.en: The supportive friend who's a bully at work.
sentences.zh: 那个在工作场合欺凌他人，却又是你支持者的朋友。

sentences.en: The hated politician who passes a law that we like.
sentences.zh: 那个通过了我们喜欢的法律，却又被我们憎恨的政客。

sentences.en: These contradictions can be especially difficult within closed relationships,
sentences.zh: 这些矛盾在亲密关系中尤其难以处理，

sentences.en: when the people who mean the most to us are also the ones who hurt us deeply.
sentences.zh: 因为那些对我们最重要的人，往往也是伤害我们最深的人。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, the story of a woman named Stephanie Kellan
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》，讲述了一位名叫斯蒂芬妮·凯兰的女性的故事，

sentences.en: and her complicated relationship with a friend named Kim.
sentences.zh: 以及她与一位名叫金的朋友之间复杂的关系。

sentences.en: We explore what their unusual story reveals about a mental ability
sentences.zh: 我们探讨了她们不同寻常的故事揭示了一种怎样的心理能力，

sentences.en: that allows us to see the world in all its complexity.
sentences.zh: 这种能力让我们能够以其全部复杂性来看待世界。

sentences.en: A quick note if you're listening with small children,
sentences.zh: 温馨提示：如果您正在和年幼的孩子一起收听，

sentences.en: this episode includes discussions of addiction and a suicide attempt.
sentences.zh: 本期节目包含关于成瘾和自杀未遂的讨论。

sentences.en: In college, Stephanie Kellan always felt there were two Stephanies inside her.
sentences.zh: 在大学里，斯蒂芬妮·凯兰总觉得身体里住着两个斯蒂芬妮。

sentences.en: One was a student who kept everything together,
sentences.zh: 一个是把一切都打理得井井有条的学生，

sentences.en: the only one who woke up for 8 a.m.
sentences.zh: 她是新生里唯一一个能按时起床上早上8点课程的人。

sentences.en: classes as a freshman.
sentences.zh: 也是宿舍楼里唯一一个不喝酒的人。

sentences.en: The only one on her dorm floor who didn't drink.
sentences.zh: 另一个斯蒂芬妮则背负着童年时代的几个心魔。

sentences.en: The other Stephanie carried around several demons from her childhood.
sentences.zh: 她的家庭经常搬家，

sentences.en: Her family had moved around a lot,
sentences.zh: 在她18岁之前，住过10个不同的地方。

sentences.en: living in 10 different homes by the time she was 18.
sentences.zh: 他们很穷。

sentences.en: They were poor.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮说，多年来，她一直受到身边人的虐待。

sentences.en: For years, Stephanie says, she was abused by someone close.
sentences.zh: 21岁那年，她第一次喝了酒。

sentences.en: When she turned 21, she had a drink for the first time.
sentences.zh: 于是，那个无人可见的斯蒂芬妮爆发了出来。

sentences.en: And the Stephanie no one else could see burst into view.
sentences.zh: 酒精第一次触碰我的嘴唇时，我就已经是在酗酒了。

sentences.en: The first time that alcohol hit my lips, I was drinking alcoholically.
sentences.zh: 我没有循序渐进的过程。

sentences.en: I had no buildup.
sentences.zh: 我没有那种“哦，我只是去参加个派对”的想法。

sentences.en: I had no, oh, I'm just going to party.
sentences.zh: 完全没有。

sentences.en: Nope.
sentences.zh: 从21岁生日那天起，我一喝就是喝到断片。

sentences.en: It was drink to blackout from the get-go, from my 21st birthday.
sentences.zh: 所以我维持着外在的形象，那个循规蹈矩、从不犯错、成绩全A、事事做得完美的女孩。

sentences.en: So I kept up the outer view of me, where I was this straight-laced girl who never did anything wrong and got straight A's and did everything right.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，她成功地平衡了这两种生活。

sentences.en: For a while, she managed to juggle both lives.
sentences.zh: 她想成为一名钢琴老师，并且坚持完成了学业。

sentences.en: She wanted to be a piano teacher, and she kept up with her schoolwork.
sentences.zh: 当我能熬到晚上，做完所有作业并练完所有钢琴曲的时候，

sentences.en: When I could get to the point of the evening where I didn't have any homework left and I had done all of my piano practicing,
sentences.zh: 我会喝掉整整一瓶薄荷利口酒，然后直接断片，接着又爬起来去上早上8点的课，强迫自己，不断地强迫自己。

sentences.en: I would drink an entire bottle of peppermint schnapps, for example, and just black out and then get up for my 8 a.m.
sentences.zh: 大学毕业时，这就是我的模式。

sentences.en: classes and push myself and push myself.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮在2001年以优异成绩毕业。

sentences.en: And when I graduated from college, this was my my pattern.
sentences.zh: 第二年，她在教会的单身聚会上遇到了一个可爱的男人，不久他们就结婚了。

sentences.en: Stephanie graduated with high honors in 2001.
sentences.zh: 她实现了梦想，找到了一份小学音乐老师的工作。

sentences.en: She met a cute guy at a church singles group the next year, and soon they got married.
sentences.zh: 她的伴侣也有一份不错的工作。

sentences.en: She achieved her dream, landing a job as an elementary school music teacher.
sentences.zh: 从外表看，他们的生活光鲜亮丽。

sentences.en: Her partner had a good job, too.
sentences.zh: 我们在家里举办公司晚宴，我主持着那些大型而精致的晚宴派对。

sentences.en: From the outside, their lives looked glamorous.
sentences.zh: 但当然，之后我会独自喝掉整整一瓶伏特加。

sentences.en: We were having corporate dinners at our house, and I was hosting these big elaborate dinner parties.
sentences.zh: 这种模式持续了近七年。

sentences.en: But then, of course, would then drink a whole bottle of vodka when I was alone.
sentences.zh: 白天教孩子，晚上做体面的公司高管妻子，

sentences.en: The pattern continued for nearly seven years.
sentences.zh: 晚上喝到断片。

sentences.en: Teach kids during the day, be the good corporate wife in the evening,
sentences.zh: 2009年1月，斯蒂芬妮的婚姻破裂了。

sentences.en: drink until she blacked out at night.
sentences.zh: 她觉得没必要再伪装下去了。

sentences.en: In January 2009, Stephanie's marriage collapsed.
sentences.zh: 暑假学校放假时，她开始全天候酗酒。

sentences.en: She felt like she didn't need to fake things anymore.
sentences.zh: 醒来，喝酒，断片。

sentences.en: When school let out for the summer, she started drinking around the clock.
sentences.zh: 循环往复。

sentences.en: Wake up, drink, blackout.
sentences.zh: 那时我30岁。

sentences.en: Repeat.
sentences.zh: 生活把我彻底毁了。

sentences.en: And here I was, 30 years old.
sentences.zh: 于是我的双重生活变成了一种生活。

sentences.en: Life had screwed me over.
sentences.zh: 变成了我的酗酒生活。

sentences.en: So my double life became one life.
sentences.zh: 我不再试图隐藏我的痛苦了。

sentences.en: And it became my alcoholic life.
sentences.zh: 在她心中，存在着“好斯蒂芬妮”和“坏斯蒂芬妮”。

sentences.en: And I didn't try to hide my pain anymore.
sentences.zh: 好斯蒂芬妮教孩子们音乐，努力工作。

sentences.en: In her mind, there was good Stephanie and there was bad Stephanie.
sentences.zh: 坏斯蒂芬妮喝到断片，放弃了梦想。

sentences.en: Good Stephanie taught kids music, worked hard.
sentences.zh: 中间没有任何过渡。

sentences.en: Bad Stephanie drank to blackout, abandoned her dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 2009年6月的一天，她整夜酗酒后醒来，直接伸手去拿伏特加。

sentences.en: There was no one in between.
sentences.zh: 但有什么东西让我停了下来。

sentences.en: One day in June 2009, she woke up from drinking all night and reached straight for her vodka.
sentences.zh: 我没有去拿伏特加，而是走向了电脑。

sentences.en: But something, though, made me stop.
sentences.zh: 我搜索了AA（匿名戒酒互助社）。

sentences.en: Instead of my vodka, I went to my computer.
sentences.zh: AA当然就是匿名戒酒互助社，是为对抗酒精成瘾的人提供的支持小组。

sentences.en: And I looked up AA.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮参加了一次AA会议。

sentences.en: AA, of course, is Alcoholics Anonymous, the support group for people fighting alcohol addiction.
sentences.zh: 会议结束后，一位女士走过来做了自我介绍。

sentences.en: Stephanie went to an AA meeting.
sentences.zh: 出于稍后会明了的原因，我们只用她的名字，金。

sentences.en: When it was over, a woman walked up and introduced herself.
sentences.zh: 她是一个开朗、有魅力、身高一米七八、金发碧眼的漂亮女孩。

sentences.en: For reasons that will become clear, we're only using her first name, Kim.
sentences.zh: 那种在高中时期根本不会正眼看我一眼的女孩。

sentences.en: She was just this bright, charismatic girl, 5'10", blonde, gorgeous.
sentences.zh: 她有一种自信的姿态。

sentences.en: One of those girls that would never have even given me the time of day in high school.
sentences.zh: 她身上有一种气质，让你觉得可以对她倾诉一切。

sentences.en: She had a swagger.
sentences.zh: 那是一种对自我的自信，同时也是“信任”意义上的自信，

sentences.en: She had this air about her that made you feel like you could tell her anything.
sentences.zh: 你可以把她当作知己，告诉她任何事。

sentences.en: This confidence in her own self, but also this confidence in the other sense of the word,
sentences.zh: 一个能瞬间成为你挚友的人。

sentences.en: that you could bring her into your confidence and tell her anything.
sentences.zh: 她走到我面前，给了我她的电话号码，

sentences.en: Someone who would be your instant best friend.
sentences.zh: 并对我说，打给我。

sentences.en: And she comes over to me and she gives me her phone number.
sentences.zh: 无论发生什么，无论什么时候，

sentences.en: and says to me, call me.
sentences.zh: 白天还是晚上，打给我。

sentences.en: No matter what, whenever it is,
sentences.zh: 这是第一次有人看到了真实的我，

sentences.en: day or night, call me.
sentences.zh: 却依然愿意和我交谈。

sentences.en: It was the first time anyone had ever seen the real me
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮不断回到AA会议，

sentences.en: and still wanted to talk to me.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是因为她想多见见这位新朋友。

sentences.en: Stephanie kept returning to AA meetings,
sentences.zh: 金把斯蒂芬妮介绍给了其他常客。

sentences.en: partly because she wanted to see more of her new friend.
sentences.zh: 她会关心她的近况。

sentences.en: Kim introduced Stephanie to other regulars.
sentences.zh: 几周后，斯蒂芬妮深夜未眠，因为不喝酒，大脑在不停地打转。

sentences.en: She checked in on her.
sentences.zh: 她在公寓里踱步，不停地抽烟，清醒得不得了。

sentences.en: A few weeks later, Stephanie was up late at night, her mind spinning in circles from not drinking.
sentences.zh: 突然，她产生了一个疯狂的冲动。

sentences.en: She paced her apartment, chain-smoking, wide awake.
sentences.zh: 我是一个狂热的读者，有三个装满书的书架。

sentences.en: Suddenly, she had a mad impulse.
sentences.zh: 当时是午夜一点，我在这间小公寓里，发现为了保持清醒，我必须立刻把书按字母顺序排列。

sentences.en: I'm an avid reader, and I had three bookshelves full of books.
sentences.zh: 我把书架上所有的书都拿下来，

sentences.en: and here I am in my little apartment at midnight, one in the morning, and I find that in order to
sentences.zh: 书铺满了客厅地板，我开始按字母排序，但排完一个书架后，

sentences.en: stay sober, I have to alphabetize my books right now.
sentences.zh: 我心想，等等，我应该按书名还是作者姓氏排序？

sentences.en: I take all my books off my shelf and all my
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: books are on my apartment living room floor and I start alphabetizing, but then I get one shelf in
sentences.zh: 排到第二个书架时，我心想，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And I think, wait, should I alphabetize it by title or by author last name?
sentences.zh: 我应该打个电话给谁。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 于是我在凌晨两点打给了金。

sentences.en: I, about two shelves in, go, you know what?
sentences.zh: 她接了电话。

sentences.en: I should call someone.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她，我要疯了。

sentences.en: And I call Kim at two in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我在给书按字母排序。

sentences.en: She picks up.
sentences.zh: 她说，过来吧。

sentences.en: I tell her, I'm going crazy.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮开车五分钟到了金家，对这位新朋友充满了感激。

sentences.en: I'm alphabetizing my books.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，我试图保持清醒，睡在她的沙发上。

sentences.en: And she says, come on over.
sentences.zh: 早上，她说，嘿，我正在找室友。

sentences.en: Stephanie drove the five minutes to Kim's house, full of gratitude for her new friend.
sentences.zh: 我说，好啊。

sentences.en: That night, I was trying to stay sober, sleeping on her couch.
sentences.zh: 这是我一生中受到的最好的待遇。

sentences.en: In the morning, she was like, hey, I'm looking for a roommate.
sentences.zh: 我要和这个女孩住在一起。

sentences.en: And I was like, sure.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮准备搬家，开始花越来越多的时间陪金。

sentences.en: This is the nicest anyone has treated me in my entire life.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几周里，我开始认识其他人，并会去她家。

sentences.en: I'll move in with this girl.
sentences.zh: 她会邀请人过来。

sentences.en: Stephanie prepared for the move, and she began spending more and more time with Kim.
sentences.zh: 她会举办大型的无酒精派对。

sentences.en: Over those next weeks, I started meeting other people and would go to her house.
sentences.zh: 我会和会议上认识的人在丹佛科尔法克斯大街上一家叫“皮特厨房”的24小时餐馆通宵聊天。

sentences.en: She would have people over.
sentences.zh: 我们互相陪伴，努力不去喝酒。

sentences.en: She would have huge sober parties.
sentences.zh: 对斯蒂芬妮来说，AA小组是一条生命线，一片绿洲。

sentences.en: And I would stay up all night at a 24-hour diner on Colfax in Denver called Pete's Kitchen with people from the meetings.
sentences.zh: 而核心就是这位新朋友金，

sentences.en: And we would just keep each other company to try to not drink.
sentences.zh: 她总是在她跌倒时扶她一把。

sentences.en: For Stephanie, the AA group was a lifeline, an oasis.
sentences.zh: 那是一段非常美好的时光，寻找同伴并与人坦诚相待。

sentences.en: And at the center of it was this new friend, Kim,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我却无法坚持超过几天不喝酒，之后又会回到瓶子里去。

sentences.en: who was there to pick her up whenever she stumbled.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮不仅是在努力保持清醒。

sentences.en: It was a really beautiful time of finding people and being real with people.
sentences.zh: 她还在与日益加深的抑郁症作斗争。

sentences.en: At the same time, just not really being able to string together
sentences.zh: 提示：接下来的故事内容涉及自杀。

sentences.en: any more than a few days before I would go back to the bottle.
sentences.zh: 我当时有一种信念，认为好事不该发生在我身上。

sentences.en: Stephanie wasn't struggling just to remain sober.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮不仅是在努力保持清醒。

sentences.en: She was struggling with increasingly deep depression.
sentences.zh: 她还在与日益加深的抑郁症作斗争。

sentences.en: A note that this next part of the story has to do with suicide.
sentences.zh: 提示：接下来的故事内容涉及自杀。

sentences.en: I had this belief that things weren't supposed to be good for me.
sentences.zh: 我当时有一种信念，认为好事不该发生在我身上。

sentences.en: Nothing would actually ever get good because nothing in my life ever was good.
sentences.zh: 生活里从来没有过什么好事，所以我总觉得一切都不会好起来。

sentences.en: And I was convinced that death was the only option
sentences.zh: 我当时认定死亡是唯一的选择，

sentences.en: because I was never going to be able to have a happy life.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得自己这辈子注定无法过上幸福的生活。

sentences.en: One night, she was in her apartment, alone.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，她独自待在公寓里。

sentences.en: She had missed that day's AA meeting.
sentences.zh: 她错过了当天的戒酒互助会。

sentences.en: I had already drunk the handle of vodka,
sentences.zh: 我已经喝掉了一整瓶伏特加，

sentences.en: and I had my pills ready.
sentences.zh: 药也准备好了。

sentences.en: And I said, I don't see a way out.
sentences.zh: 我说，我找不到出路了。

sentences.en: I don't see a way to have a happy life because it's all just going to become s**t anyway.
sentences.zh: 我看不出有什么办法能过上幸福生活，因为一切终究会变得一团糟。

sentences.en: And I don't see a way to escape the bad.
sentences.zh: 我找不到逃避痛苦的方法。

sentences.en: That was when Kim called me.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，金给我打了电话。

sentences.en: Miracle number one was that I actually picked up the phone and that she called me at that moment.
sentences.zh: 第一个奇迹是，她偏偏在那一刻打来电话，而我竟然接了。

sentences.en: And she called me to see why I wasn't at that daily meeting.
sentences.zh: 她打电话是想问我为什么没去参加当天的例会。

sentences.en: Miracle number two was that I was honest with her, and I told her, I'm going to kill myself.
sentences.zh: 第二个奇迹是，我当时对她说了实话，告诉她我要自杀。

sentences.en: And I don't remember what was going through my head, except that I just didn't care anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不记得当时脑子里在想什么，只记得我什么都不在乎了。

sentences.en: Just didn't care.
sentences.zh: 什么都不在乎了。

sentences.en: Couldn't see any way out.
sentences.zh: 看不到任何出路。

sentences.en: Couldn't see which way to go.
sentences.zh: 不知道该往哪走。

sentences.en: Just didn't care what happened to me.
sentences.zh: 根本不在乎自己会怎样。

sentences.en: Didn't care who knew.
sentences.zh: 不在乎谁会知道。

sentences.en: So as soon as I said, well, I'm sitting here going to kill myself, she just said, oh, I'll be right over.
sentences.zh: 所以当我刚说完“我正坐在这儿准备自杀”时，她只说了一句：“噢，我马上过来。”

sentences.en: When we come back, how Kim saved Stephanie's life.
sentences.zh: 稍后回来，听听金是如何挽救斯蒂芬妮生命的。

sentences.en: You're listening to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 您正在收听的是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: Every day from the moment we wake up, our minds are interpreting the things we see,
sentences.zh: 每天从我们醒来的那一刻起，大脑就在解读我们所见的事物，

sentences.en: like Edgar Rubin's famous image, and telling us,
sentences.zh: 就像埃德加·鲁宾那张著名的图画，它告诉我们，

sentences.en: this is a vase, or these are two faces.
sentences.zh: 这是一个花瓶，或者这是两张人脸。

sentences.en: So much of this happens outside of conscious awareness.
sentences.zh: 这一切大多发生在我们的意识之外。

sentences.en: We rarely stop and think about whether we are seeing a complete view of the world
sentences.zh: 我们很少停下来思考，我们所看到的究竟是否是世界的全貌，

sentences.en: if we are seeing things in all that complexity.
sentences.zh: 我们是否看清了事物所有的复杂性。

sentences.en: Some people seem better than others at holding competing concepts in their heads.
sentences.zh: 有些人似乎比别人更擅长在脑海中同时容纳相互冲突的概念。

sentences.en: Psychologists call this integrative complexity.
sentences.zh: 心理学家称之为“整合复杂性”。

sentences.en: Can you see that Edgar Rubin's picture is not just a vase, and it's not just two faces, but both at the same time?
sentences.zh: 你能看出埃德加·鲁宾的那张图不仅仅是一个花瓶，也不仅仅是两张人脸，而是两者兼具吗？

sentences.en: Our social groups often yank us away from integrative complexity.
sentences.zh: 我们的社交群体往往会将我们从整合复杂性中拉开。

sentences.en: Our tribes often want us to see things as they see them.
sentences.zh: 我们的部落往往希望我们以他们的视角看问题。

sentences.en: Take a hot-button issue like abortion.
sentences.zh: 以堕胎这种敏感议题为例。

sentences.en: Opponents of abortion say it's about the life of an unborn child.
sentences.zh: 反对堕胎的人说，这关乎一个未出生孩子的生命。

sentences.en: Supporters of abortion rights say the central issue is a woman's right to choose.
sentences.zh: 支持堕胎权的人则说，核心问题是女性的选择权。

sentences.en: One side says, ending a life is wrong.
sentences.zh: 一方说，结束生命是错误的。

sentences.en: There's nothing else to talk about.
sentences.zh: 没什么好谈的。

sentences.en: The other side says, a woman's control over her own body is sacrosanct.
sentences.zh: 另一方说，女性对自己身体的掌控权是神圣不可侵犯的。

sentences.en: There's nothing else to
sentences.zh: 没什么好

sentences.en: discuss.
sentences.zh: 讨论的。

sentences.en: If you have strong views on the subject, but attempt to understand where the other side
sentences.zh: 如果你在这个问题上有强烈的观点，但试图去理解对方的立场，

sentences.en: is coming from, chances are that the people on your side will come down on you like a ton of
sentences.zh: 那么你所在阵营的人很可能会对你进行猛烈的

sentences.en: bricks.
sentences.zh: 抨击。

sentences.en: One reason integrative complexity is so hard, it might seem, sometimes even in our own
sentences.zh: 整合复杂性之所以如此困难，一个原因在于，有时即便在我们自己的

sentences.en: minds, like disloyalty.
sentences.zh: 脑海中，它似乎也像是一种背叛。

sentences.en: At the point Stephanie Kellan tried to take her own life, there was only
sentences.zh: 在斯蒂芬妮·凯兰试图自杀的那一刻，她眼中

sentences.en: one way for her to see her friend Kim.
sentences.zh: 只有一种看待朋友金的方式。

sentences.en: She was an unambiguous force for good.
sentences.zh: 她是纯粹的善意化身。

sentences.en: When Stephanie told
sentences.zh: 当斯蒂芬妮告诉

sentences.en: Kim what she was doing, Kim dropped everything and rushed over.
sentences.zh: 金她要做什么时，金放下一切冲了过来。

sentences.en: The rest is a little bit foggy.
sentences.zh: 剩下的记忆有些模糊。

sentences.en: Because I was already drunk.
sentences.zh: 因为我当时已经喝醉了。

sentences.en: I remember her coming into my apartment.
sentences.zh: 我记得她走进我的公寓。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不确定。

sentences.en: It could have been two minutes later, could have been 15 minutes later.
sentences.zh: 可能是两分钟后，也可能是15分钟后。

sentences.en: I remember her walking kind of like as if in a dream.
sentences.zh: 我记得她走过来，感觉就像在梦里一样。

sentences.en: Her walking me down to her car, putting me in her car,
sentences.zh: 她带我下楼坐进她的车，把我安置在车里，

sentences.en: driving me to the hospital, to the emergency room.
sentences.zh: 开车送我去了医院，去了急诊室。

sentences.en: She tried to get me to fill out the information, but I didn't care.
sentences.zh: 她试图让我填写信息，但我根本不在乎。

sentences.en: I just didn't care.
sentences.zh: 我就是不在乎。

sentences.en: I was put on a 72-hour suicide hold in their psych unit, and they put me to bed.
sentences.zh: 我被送进了精神科病房，接受72小时的自杀监护，他们让我躺下休息。

sentences.en: It was the most horrible, but also the most freeing moment of my entire life.
sentences.zh: 那是我一生中最可怕，但也是最解脱的时刻。

sentences.en: all of my pretenses were gone.
sentences.zh: 我所有的伪装都消失了。

sentences.en: I just let go.
sentences.zh: 我彻底放下了。

sentences.en: I found out later that I had been going through
sentences.zh: 后来我才知道，我当时经历了

sentences.en: alcoholic seizures.
sentences.zh: 酒精戒断性癫痫。

sentences.en: It was as if I was in water, and I was just surfacing every now and then,
sentences.zh: 感觉就像我沉在水里，偶尔浮出水面透口气，

sentences.en: surfacing.
sentences.zh: 浮出水面。

sentences.en: And that's how I lived for three days.
sentences.zh: 那三天我就是这样度过的。

sentences.en: After three days, Stephanie entered long-term
sentences.zh: 三天后，斯蒂芬妮进入了医院的长期

sentences.en: care in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 护理阶段。

sentences.en: She started the path to recovery.
sentences.zh: 她开始了康复之路。

sentences.en: She still remembers the moment when
sentences.zh: 她至今仍记得那个时刻，

sentences.en: she finally surfaced for good.
sentences.zh: 她终于彻底清醒了过来。

sentences.en: I was sitting in our group and outside the window, the sun was
sentences.zh: 我坐在小组里，窗外夕阳

sentences.en: setting and it was shining right in my eye.
sentences.zh: 西下，阳光直射进我的眼睛。

sentences.en: And it just was that moment of, I don't want to miss
sentences.zh: 那一刻我突然想到：我不想错过

sentences.en: this?
sentences.zh: 这一切？

sentences.en: What am I doing?
sentences.zh: 我在做什么？

sentences.en: I want to live.
sentences.zh: 我想活下去。

sentences.en: This is a beautiful world.
sentences.zh: 这个世界真美。

sentences.en: And then followed by, wow,
sentences.zh: 紧接着我又想：哇，

sentences.en: that girl saved my life.
sentences.zh: 那个女孩救了我的命。

sentences.en: Followed by, I need to get sober, you know, just like one after another,
sentences.zh: 接着又想：我需要戒酒。你知道，就像一个接一个的念头，

sentences.en: just boom, boom.
sentences.zh: 砰，砰。

sentences.en: It came around to my time to share.
sentences.zh: 轮到我分享了。

sentences.en: And I just remember saying, guys,
sentences.zh: 我记得我当时说：伙计们，

sentences.en: I want to live.
sentences.zh: 我想活下去。

sentences.en: And the room just erupted in cheering and was like, yes, you did it.
sentences.zh: 房间里顿时爆发出欢呼声，大家说：太棒了，你做到了。

sentences.en: And it was amazing.
sentences.zh: 那感觉太奇妙了。

sentences.en: I'll never forget it.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记。

sentences.en: Kim didn't just save her life.
sentences.zh: 金不仅救了她的命。

sentences.en: She helped to run Stephanie's life while she was in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 在斯蒂芬妮住院期间，她还帮她打理生活。

sentences.en: While I was in the suicide hold and the two weeks in the psych ward, I didn't have my phone or my wallet or any of that because they want you, of course,
sentences.zh: 当我在接受自杀监护和在精神科病房待的两周里，我没有手机、钱包或任何东西，因为他们当然希望

sentences.en: to be disconnected from the outside world in order to focus on recovery.
sentences.zh: 你与外界隔绝，以便专注于康复。

sentences.en: So she took care of all of that for me.
sentences.zh: 所以她帮我处理了所有这些琐事。

sentences.en: At that time, I was still paying bills through check.
sentences.zh: 那时，我还在用支票支付账单。

sentences.en: So she took my checkbook and I would sign a few checks and she would pay my bills for me.
sentences.zh: 所以她拿走了我的支票簿，我签几张支票，她就帮我付账。

sentences.en: She didn't have a car of her own.
sentences.zh: 她自己没有车。

sentences.en: So she drove my car while I was in the hospital, but would fill it with gas and she would wash it and make sure that it was all ready for me when I got out.
sentences.zh: 所以我在住院期间她开着我的车，但她会给车加油、洗车，确保我出院时一切都准备好了。

sentences.en: I needed to put some of my things in storage, so she took care of a storage unit.
sentences.zh: 我需要把一些东西存进仓库，所以她帮我租了一个储物间。

sentences.en: So I had all this jewelry and my wedding ring from my divorce at that time.
sentences.zh: 当时我所有的珠宝和离婚时的婚戒都在里面。

sentences.en: And yeah, it just went above and beyond.
sentences.zh: 是的，她真的做得超出了朋友的范畴。

sentences.en: When Stephanie got out of the hospital, her lease on her apartment was about to end.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮出院时，她的公寓租约即将到期。

sentences.en: Kim invited her to move in.
sentences.zh: 金邀请她搬过去住。

sentences.en: I was like, yes, of course I'll move in with you.
sentences.zh: 我说：好啊，当然，我搬去和你住。

sentences.en: And all I had to do was just basically drive over to my new apartment with her.
sentences.zh: 我所要做的基本上就是和她一起开车去我的新公寓。

sentences.en: But I mean, at this point, this is somebody who is playing more than a role of a friend.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，到这一步，她扮演的角色已经不仅仅是朋友了。

sentences.en: I mean, she comes over, saves your life, takes you to the ER, looks after your affairs, pays
sentences.zh: 我是说，她跑过来救你的命，送你去急诊室，照顾你的私事，付

sentences.en: your bill, pays your rent, looks after your car, gets you to sort of sign a lease, moving
sentences.zh: 你的账单，付你的房租，照顾你的车，让你去签租约，搬

sentences.en: into her place, moves your stuff into storage, essentially have you come over.
sentences.zh: 进她的住处，把你的东西搬进仓库，本质上就是让你搬过去。

sentences.en: I mean, at this point, she's almost a parent to you.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在这一点上，她几乎就像你的父母。

sentences.en: Oh, she was everything.
sentences.zh: 噢，她就是一切。

sentences.en: She was a pseudo-parent is the right word for it.
sentences.zh: “准父母”这个词形容她再合适不过了。

sentences.en: I was nothing but grateful to her, obliged to her, kind of dependent upon her.
sentences.zh: 我对她只有感激，觉得亏欠她，甚至有点依赖她。

sentences.en: Anything that she needed, it was yes.
sentences.zh: 只要她需要什么，我都会说好。

sentences.en: Stephanie trusted Kim in a way she had never done with another human being.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮对金的信任，是她从未给予过任何人的。

sentences.en: I would still have those sleepless nights where I would kind of just be out of my mind
sentences.zh: 我依然会有那些失眠的夜晚，脑子里总是

sentences.en: with wanting to drink and one night we sat on our front porch smoking away into the night
sentences.zh: 想喝酒。一天晚上，我们坐在前廊抽烟到深夜，

sentences.en: and as we smoked cigarettes out there she started asking me about my past and I found
sentences.zh: 我们在外面抽着烟，她开始问起我的过去，我发现

sentences.en: myself telling her things I'd never told anyone in my entire life.
sentences.zh: 自己竟然告诉了她我这辈子从未对任何人说过的事。

sentences.en: Stephanie shared details about
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮分享了关于

sentences.en: her troubled childhood and the trauma of living in poverty and being abused.
sentences.zh: 她坎坷童年的细节，以及生活在贫困和虐待中的创伤。

sentences.en: She told me about when someone does a bad thing, shame is created.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，当有人做了坏事，羞耻感就会产生。

sentences.en: And she said, think of shame as a black ball.
sentences.zh: 她说，把羞耻感想象成一个黑球。

sentences.en: And somebody has to hold that black ball.
sentences.zh: 总得有人拿着那个黑球。

sentences.en: And often it's the victims who end up holding that black ball.
sentences.zh: 而往往是受害者最终背负着那个黑球。

sentences.en: Kim told Stephanie that the ball of shame she was carrying around wasn't hers to hold any longer.
sentences.zh: 金告诉斯蒂芬妮，她背负的那个羞耻之球不再属于她了。

sentences.en: I cried, and we hugged, and I felt listened to for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我哭了，我们拥抱在一起，我第一次感到自己被倾听了。

sentences.en: As winter turned to spring, the two women grew closer and closer.
sentences.zh: 随着冬去春来，两人的关系越来越亲密。

sentences.en: Stephanie had gone back to work after getting out of the hospital, and staying with Kim helped keep her sober.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮出院后重返工作岗位，和金住在一起帮助她保持了清醒。

sentences.en: At one point, Kim asked Stephanie for a $4,000 loan.
sentences.zh: 有一次，金向斯蒂芬妮借了4000美元。

sentences.en: Stephanie had alimony from her divorce and lent Kim the money.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮有离婚后的赡养费，就借给了金。

sentences.en: It felt like the least she could do.
sentences.zh: 她觉得这是她至少能做的事。

sentences.en: In April 2010, Stephanie relapsed.
sentences.zh: 2010年4月，斯蒂芬妮复吸了。

sentences.en: She went back to rehab, this time for four months.
sentences.zh: 她回到了康复中心，这次待了四个月。

sentences.en: Kim took care of her affairs while she was away, as before.
sentences.zh: 像往常一样，金在她离开期间帮她处理了事务。

sentences.en: When Stephanie left rehab, Kim had moved into a new apartment.
sentences.zh: 当斯蒂芬妮离开康复中心时，金已经搬进了新公寓。

sentences.en: She invited Stephanie to join her again.
sentences.zh: 她再次邀请斯蒂芬妮和她住在一起。

sentences.en: But I had decided that I needed to try things on my own.
sentences.zh: 但我决定，我需要尝试独立生活。

sentences.en: And, you know, she supported that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她支持我的决定。

sentences.en: The rehab program set Stephanie up with a furnished apartment.
sentences.zh: 康复项目为斯蒂芬妮安排了一间带家具的公寓。

sentences.en: She moved in at the end of September 2010.
sentences.zh: 她在2010年9月底搬了进去。

sentences.en: So I moved into my, for the very first time, my very own apartment.
sentences.zh: 所以我搬进了我人生中第一间属于自己的公寓。

sentences.en: Sober, feeling great, paying all my bills, going to work, living a sober life.
sentences.zh: 保持清醒，感觉很棒，支付所有账单，去上班，过着清醒的生活。

sentences.en: feeling peaceful, feeling happy.
sentences.zh: 感到平静，感到快乐。

sentences.en: A week or so later, Stephanie invited Kim over.
sentences.zh: 大约一周后，斯蒂芬妮邀请金过来坐坐。

sentences.en: They both had things to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 她们俩都有值得庆祝的事情。

sentences.en: Stephanie was on the right track with her sobriety,
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮在戒酒方面步入了正轨，

sentences.en: and Kim had finished her studies to become a certified addictions counselor.
sentences.zh: 而金也完成了学业，成为了一名认证成瘾咨询师。

sentences.en: When Kim arrived at the door of the building,
sentences.zh: 当金到达那栋大楼门口时，

sentences.en: she called up to Stephanie to look out the window of the apartment.
sentences.zh: 她喊斯蒂芬妮从公寓窗户往外看。

sentences.en: So I go over, and I look out the window, and I look down,
sentences.zh: 于是我走过去，看向窗外，往下看，

sentences.en: and there she is on the curb in front of my apartment building,
sentences.zh: 就看到她站在我公寓楼前的路边，

sentences.en: with this brand new Dodge.
sentences.zh: 开着一辆崭新的道奇车。

sentences.en: She had been driving beaters and then they had died and then she
sentences.zh: 她以前一直开着破旧的车，后来车报废了，她就

sentences.en: wasn't driving and she was just walking.
sentences.zh: 没车开了，只能走路。

sentences.en: And she's like, I got a new car.
sentences.zh: 她说，我买了辆新车。

sentences.en: And at that point,
sentences.zh: 当时，

sentences.en: she had started working at a rehab.
sentences.zh: 她已经开始在一家康复中心工作了。

sentences.en: She was doing really good salary-wise.
sentences.zh: 她的薪水相当不错。

sentences.en: And here I was
sentences.zh: 而我呢，

sentences.en: sober and in my own place and everything was great.
sentences.zh: 戒了酒，有了自己的住处，一切都很棒。

sentences.en: And it was just thrilling.
sentences.zh: 那真是太令人激动了。

sentences.en: And we were
sentences.zh: 我们当时

sentences.en: night was wonderful.
sentences.zh: 那个夜晚非常美妙。

sentences.en: A short while later, Kim returned the favor.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，金也回请了她。

sentences.en: She invited Stephanie over
sentences.zh: 她邀请斯蒂芬妮去

sentences.en: to her place.
sentences.zh: 她家做客。

sentences.en: Her new place was this gorgeous penthouse apartment in this really upscale
sentences.zh: 她的新住处是一间华丽的顶层公寓，位于一个非常高档的
